Opponent takes no battle damagethis battle. OR Deploy one Dewback from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”<ref name="cl-1210_55-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
